steps.do: Before you start: start CALIBER with CALIBER_FEATURE_RELEASE_CANDIDATES=true; the section is off by default. Open Releases and scroll to Release signoff factory. Signing off here is record-only: it deploys nothing.
steps.see: A violet note: Signing off a release candidate records a decision. It does not deploy or roll back anything.

steps.do: Click New candidate and enter row RC16 from release-candidates.jsonl: the artifact, versions and required score, with its criteria and evidence arrays pasted into the two JSON boxes. The form records the planned action (promote_workflow to prod) for you.
steps.see: The card reads blocked, 72%, 4 criteria · 1 evidence · 1 blockers · rollback 4 and, in red, Blocked by rollback_rehearsed: scored 0.5, needs 1; Sign off GO is disabled. (The other 19 rows go in the same way: 14 read ready, 6 blocked.)

steps.do: As an admin, enter the criterion key the card named and a reason of at least 8 characters, with the compensating control; optionally pick a Waiver expiry date (the blocker returns after it), and click Record waiver. A waiver clears a blocker; it does not change the score.
fill: Rollback rehearsal booked for the 25th; on-call holds the previous image. Owner: release-eng.
steps.see: The card reads ready, 0 blockers, still 72%, and an amber line names the waiver: who granted it, its expiry and the reason.

steps.do: Click Re-evaluate. It recomputes from what is stored. There is no way to edit a candidate: to change a score, create a new candidate.
Click Generate Allure. The report is a snapshot of the candidate now: generate the one you intend to keep after the last waiver.
steps.see: Allure report RRJ-… generated and retained. Note the id.

steps.do: Type a Signoff rationale (two characters keep Sign off GO disabled; at least 8 enable it) and click Sign off GO.
steps.see: The badge reads signed_go and the rationale box and both sign-off buttons are gone: a signed candidate is final.

steps.do: Create row RC05 the same way (Prompt, pricing-quote, version 9, rollback 8, required score 0.85). Its weighted score is high, but human review is below its blocking threshold. Sign off GO stays disabled; with a rationale, click Sign off NO-GO.
steps.see: 95%, blocked, then signed_no_go: a refusal is a decision too.

steps.do: Create row RC17 (workflow, required score 0.85) and waive both of its blockers, regression_vs_baseline and human_review, one after the other.
steps.see: 0 blockers but still blocked: No blocking criterion is unmet, but the weighted score 66% is under the required 85%. A waiver cannot raise a score. Sign off GO stays disabled.

steps.do: A candidate can never be edited. When RC16's rehearsal is done, create it again for the next package version: Candidate version 6, Rollback version 5, and rollback_rehearsed scored 1 in the criteria box.
steps.see: The new card reads ready, 0 blockers, no waiver and a higher percentage than v5's 72%; the two cards side by side are the comparison.

steps.do: Create the prompt payments-assistant (New prompt, Write / paste; version 1 is live) and save a version 2 with the card's Edit. On Releases create a candidate for it from RC01's row (type Prompt, version 2, rollback 1), type a rationale and Sign off GO. Then, on Prompts, the card's Versions, press Make live on v2.
steps.see: After the signoff and a reload the live board still reads v1 and the timeline has no event for the prompt; after Make live it reads v2 and the timeline records the promotion.
The newest row of each is by admin: the audit log names who created, waived, reported and signed.

steps.do: Reload the page. Then, as lab11-viewer (no scopes), open Releases.
steps.see: Both candidates still read signed_go and signed_no_go. The viewer has no New candidate or Generate Allure button and does not see the admin's candidates (a candidate outside a workspace is private to its creator).
